maria: Quick spot-check from the GPTQ bakeoff across Llama/Mistral/Qwen - dropping a compact summary and ask for deployment guidance.

samir: Nice, post the short table please. especially INT8/GPTQ deltas vs FP16.

maria: Pasting selective results (most signal from MMLU, HellaSwag, and perplexity on two-shot-heavy prompts). These are GPTQ 4-bit (our tuned recipe) vs FP16 baseline. AWQ runs are in a separate draft.

eval-bot: ```
Llama-13B (FP16)  MMLU=62.3  HellaSwag=79.1  PPL=12.4
Llama-13B (GPTQ-4) MMLU=61.8 (-0.5) HellaSwag=78.6 (-0.5) PPL=13.1 (+0.7)
Mistral-7B (FP16) MMLU=55.1  HellaSwag=75.0  PPL=9.8
Mistral-7B (GPTQ-4) MMLU=53.6 (-1.5) HellaSwag=73.9 (-1.1) PPL=10.6 (+0.8)
Qwen-7B (FP16)   MMLU=58.0  HellaSwag=76.4  PPL=10.9
Qwen-7B (GPTQ-4) MMLU=57.4 (-0.6) HellaSwag=76.0 (-0.4) PPL=11.2 (+0.3)
```

jin: Thanks. Mistral's drop looks notable, ~1.5 MMLU points — can you split by task buckets (STEM, humanities, code) to see where it regressed?

maria: Quick bucketed deltas: STEM -1.9, humanities -1.1, code -0.2 (Mistral). So STEM-heavy prompts suffer most; appears quantization noise on numerical tokens.

rachel: Any failure-mode logs? e.g., hallucinations, tokenization mismatches?

maria: We saw occasional numeric hallucination increases in Mistral on arithmetic Qs (2-3% higher error). Tokenization mismatch not observed. AWQ runs reduce numeric error but cost/throughput tradeoffs differ.

eval-bot: AWQ-4 quick numbers (same eval suite):
```
Mistral-7B (AWQ-4) MMLU=54.8 (-0.3 vs GPTQ, -0.3 vs FP16) HellaSwag=74.7 PPL=10.2
Llama-13B (AWQ-4) MMLU=62.0 (-0.2) HellaSwag=78.8 PPL=12.6
Qwen-7B (AWQ-4)  MMLU=57.6 (-0.2) HellaSwag=76.1 PPL=11.0
```

samir: So AWQ recovers ~0.8-1.2 pts vs GPTQ for Mistral on STEM. Throughput?

maria: Throughput roughs (tokens/sec on same A10x8 config): GPTQ-4 ~430k t/s, AWQ-4 ~370k t/s, FP16 ~220k t/s (batching masks different). Memory footprints: GPTQ > AWQ slightly (due to indexing) but both fit in 24GB per shard for these families.

ops-bot: Note: Dedicated pools with 48GB A100 needed for Llama-13B FP16 at target latency. GPTQ/AWQ reduce instance class down to 24GB GPUs for cost saving.

rachel: Recommendation asked: which models are 'deploy-ready' for dedicated/shared plans?

maria: My read:
- Llama-13B (GPTQ-4): deployable on Dedicated for latency-sensitive routes; delta small (-0.5 MMLU). Use GPTQ for cost/capacity.
- Qwen-7B (GPTQ-4): safe deploy on Hosted; AWQ optional if we want slightly higher quality at throughput cost.
- Mistral-7B: avoid GPTQ-4 for STEM-heavy customers. Recommend AWQ-4 or FP16 for enterprise customers requiring numeric accuracy. Consider per-customer rolling canary with eval-set gating.

samir: For rollouts, suggest canary % and eval gating thresholds.

maria: Proposal: 5% canary -> run daily eval on owner's prompt suite; auto-rollback if MMLU drop >0.8 or STEM bucket drop >1.0; alert on PPL reg >0.6.

jin: +1 to thresholds, add token-level difference trace when alert triggers to help debugging.

rachel: Also log model variant metadata (quant recipe, kernel version, shard layout) in traces.

maria: Will add a rollout config PR and a short ops runbook. I'll also attach AWQ tuning knobs and a one-page deploy-readiness checklist.

samir: Thanks — can you drop the PR link here when ready?

maria: Will do. For now filing follow-ups: 1) AWQ tuning notes draft, 2) Mistral STEM regression investigation, 3) rollout PR.

rachel: Perfect. :thumbsup:

eval-bot: Added ephemeral artifacts to the bakeoff bucket: s3://redwood-evals/gptq-bakeoff/1749984522/{metrics,configs,raw-logs}.zip

maria: Closing thread, will open PR and tag eng-oncall and devex for rollout templates. Thanks all.
